rules.title: Boston source-of-income protection for rental assistance recipients
rules.citation: Boston Fair Housing Regulations (enforced by Fair Housing Commission)
rules.quote: In the City of Boston, it's illegal to discriminate when renting, buying, selling, or securing financing for any housing. You can't discriminate someone based on their: Race Color Religion Disability National Origin Ancestry Sex Gender Identity Gender Expression Age Sexual Orientation Marital Status Rental Assistance
rules.summary: Boston prohibits housing discrimination based on rental assistance, meaning landlords cannot refuse tenants who use Section 8 vouchers or other rental assistance.
rules.coverage_text: All housing in the City of Boston
rules.penalty: The Fair Housing Commission investigates complaints and tries to resolve findings of discrimination
